name: trioz-monorepo
description: TrioZ monorepo — the Next.js web app (apps/web), the Electron desktop shell (apps/desktop) and the shared Socket.IO contract (packages/shared).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:shared && npm run dist -w apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:release: npm run desktop:dist:auto && npm run desktop:publish -- --clean
scripts.desktop:release:docker: npm run desktop:dist:auto && npm run desktop:publish:docker
